close_reason: Filed as standalone issue JMAP-yecd.3 for full implementation; current tests cover the no-filter/no-sort path which is the common case
description: common/mod.rs MemoryBackend::query_changes takes filter, sort, max_changes, up_to_id, collapse_threads all as _ (ignored). The return value is the full unfiltered id list when since=0 and empty otherwise. Integration tests for Email/queryChanges that pass a filter or maxChanges will silently test against unfiltered results. Any test that relies on Email/queryChanges returning filtered deltas will pass even if the production backend filters incorrectly. Maintenance consequence: false-green tests give false confidence about queryChanges conformance.
title: MemoryBackend::query_changes ignores filter/sort/upToId/maxChanges
